initializationCopyBytes.description: The exact copy the matching pages cost once to initialize: every written table byte (head slots, previous links, history: 104 full 4096-byte pages and one partial page) plus the quoted page-header and bookkeeping bytes of the 105 page reservations and their ladder steps.

policy.description: The canonical matching policy every implementation of codec1 Deflate shares: at most maximumChain probes per position, none after a match of niceMatch, and only the first position of a match longer than maximumInsert enters the chains, and after a run of literals the next misses >> skipShift positions are bare literals without a search or an insert (the speed tier: about a third of the copy work of the 16/32/16 tier for about 12% more stored bytes).
